summary: In a twin test of a 2021 G80 3.5T AWD Prestige against a 2021 BMW 540i xDrive (G30, previous generation), the reviewer picks the G80 as the overall winner.

The G80 is our pick out of this duo.

summary: Reviewer states the 540i (G30) felt consistently faster than the G80 despite less power, although the G80's 375-hp V6 has plenty of low-to-mid-range power.
